title: Colmar Christmas markets 2026: dates and tips
author: Matt
intro: Colmar's six Christmas markets run from 23 November to 29 December 2026, and the gourmet market and Ferris wheel stay open until 3 January. Here's what's on where, the opening hours, and how to see it without the worst of the crowds.
seo_title: Colmar Christmas markets 2026: 23 Nov to 29 Dec
seo_description: Colmar's markets run 23 Nov to 29 Dec 2026, with the gourmet market and Ferris wheel open to 3 Jan. All six markets, opening hours and crowd tips.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Markets open:** 23 Nov to 29 Dec
- **Gourmet market:** open to 3 Jan
- **Weekday hours:** 11am to 7pm
- **Weekend hours:** 10am to 8pm
- **Time needed:** 1 or 2 days

These are the dates and hours listed for 2026, checked in October 2026. Hours change on Christmas Eve and some other days, so check the Colmar tourist office's calendar before you go.

sections.heading: The six markets
sections.text:
[Colmar](/destinations/colmar) is small, and all six markets are inside the old town, a few minutes' walk apart. You can see every one in an afternoon, but they're at their best after dark, when the timbered houses are lit up.

| Market | Where | Good for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Place des Dominicains | By the Dominican church | The classic market, under the church |
| Place de l'Ancienne Douane | Around the old customs house | Alsace food, wine and gifts |
| Koïfhus | Inside the old customs house | Indoor crafts, out of the cold |
| Little Venice | By the canal | The children's market and a letterbox for Santa |
| Place Jeanne d'Arc | Near the old town's edge | Local produce and hot drinks |
| Gourmet market | Place des Six Montagnes Noires | Food stalls, open into January |

The Koïfhus market is the one to save for a cold or rainy afternoon, because it's indoors in the town's historic customs house. The gourmet market is the one for a long lunch, with tasting stalls for Alsace cheese, foie gras, bredele biscuits and wine.

sections.heading: Opening hours for 2026
sections.text:
- **Monday to Thursday:** 11am to 7pm
- **Friday to Sunday:** 10am to 8pm
- **24 December:** 11am to 5pm
- **25 and 26 December:** 10am to 8pm

Most markets close on 29 December. The gourmet market, the Christmas fair on Place Rapp and the Ferris wheel stay open until 3 January 2027, so a trip between Christmas and New Year still has something to see, though only part of the full set.

Some guides give slightly different hours for Christmas Day and the gourmet market. If you're going on a holiday, check the official listing first rather than relying on any one blog, including this one.

sections.heading: How to beat the crowds
sections.text:
Colmar's problem is its size. It's a town of about 70,000 people with one of the most famous Christmas markets in Europe, so on December weekends the narrow streets fill with coach tours and day trippers from Strasbourg, Basel and Germany.

- **Go midweek** if you can. Monday to Thursday is much calmer.
- **Go early in the season.** The last week of November and first week of December are quieter than the run-up to Christmas.
- **Do the busiest squares in the morning**, then come back after dark for the lights.
- **Stay overnight.** Most day trippers leave by early evening, and the town is lovely late at night.

Tip: book a hotel or apartment inside or close to the old town as early as you can. Colmar has far fewer beds than Strasbourg, and December weekends sell out months ahead.

sections.heading: Getting to Colmar
sections.text:
Colmar has no airport of its own, so there are two main ways to get there from the UK:

- **By plane:** fly to Basel-Mulhouse (EuroAirport), which has direct flights from several UK airports, then take the airport bus to Saint-Louis station and a train north. It takes around an hour.
- **By train:** take the Eurostar to Paris and a TGV towards Strasbourg, then the regional train to Colmar, about half an hour from Strasbourg. It's a long day, but there's no flying.

If you're staying in [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg), Colmar makes an easy day trip, and our [Strasbourg or Colmar at Christmas](/blog/strasbourg-or-colmar-at-christmas) post compares the two in detail, with the train times.

sections.heading: Beyond the markets
sections.text:
If you have a second day, Colmar is the best base for the little wine villages of Alsace, several of which have their own small Christmas markets.

- **[Riquewihr](/destinations/riquewihr):** a walled village of painted houses, about 20 minutes by road.
- **Kaysersberg and Eguisheim:** both pretty, both with markets, and both close to Colmar.
- **The Unterlinden Museum:** in Colmar itself, home to the Isenheim Altarpiece and a good escape from the cold.

Local knowledge: some village markets only open at weekends, and local buses are infrequent in winter. A hire car or an organised tour is the easiest way to see two or three villages in a day.

sections.heading: Colmar or somewhere else?
sections.text:
Colmar is right for you if you want the prettiest setting and don't mind crowds at weekends. For a bigger city with more to do, look at [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg) or [Cologne](/blog/cologne-christmas-markets-2026), and for one of the most traditional German markets, [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg).

Our round-up of the [best Christmas markets in Europe](/blog/best-christmas-markets-in-europe) compares the main cities and their dates, and the [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) page has ideas for snow and winter sun too. If you can't agree which market to go to, put a few in a draw on [somewhere.party](/) and let it pick.

faqs.question: When is the Colmar Christmas market 2026?
faqs.answer: The markets run from 23 November to 29 December 2026. The gourmet market, the Christmas fair on Place Rapp and the Ferris wheel stay open until 3 January 2027.

faqs.question: How many Christmas markets are there in Colmar?
faqs.answer: Six, all in the old town: Place des Dominicains, Place de l'Ancienne Douane, the indoor Koïfhus, Little Venice, Place Jeanne d'Arc and the gourmet market.

faqs.question: Is the Colmar Christmas market open on Christmas Day?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's listed as open on 25 and 26 December 2026, unlike many German markets. Hours can vary on holidays, so check before you go.

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Colmar at Christmas?
faqs.answer: One day is enough for the markets. Two lets you see them after dark without rushing and add a trip to the wine villages.

faqs.question: What is the nearest airport to Colmar?
faqs.answer: Basel-Mulhouse (EuroAirport), about an hour away by bus and train. Strasbourg airport is also close but has fewer flights from the UK.
